answer.reason: Only NUM 23:28 names the mountain itself, and with its context it gives one event that happened there.

clauses.english: was where Balak brought Balaam, hoping he would curse Israel from there
clauses.quote: Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor

doubts: The verses naming Baalpeor and the matter of Peor (NUM 25, NUM 31:16, DEU 4:3, JOS 22:17, PSA 106:28) may concern the god or the idolatry and plague rather than the mountain, so they were left out.
